items.headline: Council to hold study session on Highway 17 congestion relief
items.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council is scheduled to hold a study session on the State Route 17 Corridor Congestion Relief Project.

items.headline: Escape Room entertainment venue permitted on Blossom Hill Road
items.summary: A $949,000 permit was issued for an Escape Room assembly-use space at 925 Blossom Hill Rd, one of the larger commercial permits in this batch.

items.headline: Chagee tea restaurant tenant improvement permitted at Saratoga Ave
items.summary: A $650,000 tenant improvement permit was issued for a Chagee restaurant space at 1600 Saratoga Avenue, suite 201.
